title: Hinomori Shizuku — Enamored Of Flower Stitches〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, are you watching?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: After you've made your petal, you pull your needle and thread all the way through the back...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And then, you tie the top part down by making a little hoop. This is called a “lazy daisy stitch”.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that's really cute. It looks like a little droplet.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: By repeating this process, you can make a whole flower. You can even use this to make leaves.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: The key is to sew slowly and gently so that your petal keeps its shape.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Okay, I'll give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Asahina and Haruka seem so focused.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I'm glad that they're both enjoying embroidery this much.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I can faintly hear somebody playing the trumpet...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Practicing during lunch like this means they must be very committed...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I can hear laughter from outside too...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It sounds like a fun conversation. They must be having lunch together...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Somehow, time seems to be flowing at such a gentle pace...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Having fun?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You seem to be really enjoying yourself, is all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This moment in time just feels so idyllic.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everybody seems to be enjoying their lunch break the way they like, and I'm getting to share my hobby with my friends.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As a student of this school, I feel incredibly privileged to enjoy such a lovely day.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As a student of this school...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. I know what I'm saying isn't all that profound, but somehow, it hit me so deeply just now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We haven't been able to relax much, since we're constantly practicing our singing and dancing, as well as coming up with stream ideas. Being an idol means a lot of busy hours.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So it's important to cherish these peaceful, quiet moments.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: My experience of it might be a little different from yours, but I do think it's important to have some time to switch off, as it were.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: It's easy to overwhelm yourself if you get a little too focused on studying.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
You've felt the same way, Asahina?
I didn't know we shared that.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. It happens to me all the time. Sometimes I feel like not a single thing more will fit inside my head.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But when that happens, I take a break and think slowly back on what I've learned.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: By doing so, I give myself a chance to process that information and begin comprehending it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, it is important to know your own limits.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Whenever I have trouble learning a new dance, I take a step back from practicing and try to sort out my thoughts.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That reminds me of how you make stew...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Stew?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, because you need to let it rest to bring out the flavor. Right?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
I see...
You have a point there.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
See?
There really is nothing better than a daikon slice that's soaked with flavor.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, I thought we were talking about the importance of knowing when to take a break.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Our conversation's gone in a much more appetizing direction.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I feel like having some stew now.
Some sweet and spicy lotus roots and konjac jelly would really hit the spot.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, both of those do very well as part of a stew.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I like them a lot because they're healthy and full of fiber.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What's your favorite kind of stew, Asahina?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Me?
Well, I do enjoy a good chikuzenni...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I like the crunchiness of the bamboo shoots and the softness of the taro roots.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I also love chikuzenni!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Hehe. Chatting while embroidering with my friends like this is so much fun...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, speaking of stew, Airi taught me this wonderful recipe for braised pork that just melts in your mouth...
